doc_friction.issue: redteam.py targets --probe 20 only lists files whose suite is fast, but --target on a ventures/<v>/*.mjs file runs the whole venture's **/*.test.mjs (232 s here, ~31 min for 8 mutants). The prompt says to check with targets --probe 20 first; that showed only an eval file for this venture and nothing about availability.mjs's own suite time.

The stop hook asked to commit and push while redteam.py had a live mutant in the target; following it literally would commit a seeded fault, which prompts/redteam/prompt-0.md forbids. Ignored it until the campaign restored the file.

real_defects.issue: Availability store looked up team names as plain object keys, so a team named constructor, toString, valueOf, hasOwnProperty or __proto__ got an inherited Object.prototype member: recording an answer for it threw (list.findIndex is not a function), and once anyone answered for that game the public league page and the admin page threw while rendering (function is not iterable). Reproduced with node; failing test 'team names that are Object.prototype keys...'. Fixed with own-key reads (Object.hasOwn) and defineProperty writes, so the JSON state file format is unchanged. After merging main, the roster, contacts, CSV export and reminder code added there the same day (notAnswered, parseRosters, parseContacts, availabilityCsv, remindersDue, rosterPickerHtml) repeated the pattern; CI's merge run caught it through this run's new test (notAnswered threw), and the same own-key helpers now cover those paths, with the test extended to them.

assignDivisionDuties counted duties in a plain {} keyed by the typed duty name, so a duty named constructor or toString started from the inherited function: its per-team count became the string 'function Object() { [native code] }1' and the 'fewest of this duty' fairness tie-break went NaN and was skipped; validateDivisionDuties still passed. Reproduced with node; fixed with Object.create(null) and a failing-first test.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
